Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 137.105, checked in 2026.
more_info.uses: Permitted in the US for specified flour bleaching or ageing treatments, subject to the applicable standard of identity.
more_info.overview: Acetone peroxide is a name used for a peroxide preparation listed in the US flour standard. In that application it is a bleaching and artificial-ageing agent, subject to the referenced additive regulation. The entry concerns a controlled manufacturing treatment. A specific production route or finished-food residue level was not confirmed for this historical record.
